Why Choose Sodot?

Yes, our products are highly secure, highly performant, easily integrated, audited by the best, and trusted by market leaders to secure tens of billions of dollars and millions of users.

BUT this is what really differentiates us from others:

SaaS Is Great - Not For Managing Keys
Self-hosted means: No downtime. No wait for asset support. No stuck transactions. No vendor risk.
You Are In Control
Create, iterate, change or reshape it - you own your product. We enable, not limit.
We Are Always There For You
24/7 support, 365 days a year. No exception.

Institutional Self-Custody

From small teams to banks, provide a self-custodial B2B wallet with enterprise-grade security and fine-grained policies.

Unique features:

Flexible deployment model
Dynamic signer quorum
Multi-device support

B2C Wallets

Deliver the security and UX your users deserve by eliminating seed phrases and creating a secure, delightful experience.

Unique features:

MPC & Passkeys support
Multiple key import/export options
AI agent compatibility

Payments & Stablecoins

Highly scalable and performant key management infrastructure for stablecoin and payment operations at a large scale.

Unique features:

Support for custodial and self-custodial settings
API key security for automated flows on CEXs

Crypto Trading

Highly-performant, scalable and robust key management infra for trading securely on-chain and off-chain.

Unique features:

Secure private keys and CEX API keys
HFT compatibility
Full data privacy

Regulated Custody

Secure key management for distributing custody risk between multiple admins, tech stacks, cloud providers and geographies.

Unique features:

Fully self-hosted
Self-managed policies
Multi-cloud and HSM support
